[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-16g[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Service supervision P0: honest restarts, loud failures, safe config[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]and environment[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The service host obeys its own restart decisions, an explicit [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]restart is a confirmed transition with a new pid, every failure is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]visible in a notification, the CLI, and the Services tab, a broken [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]config layer never silently stops a proc, and `sase service init` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]cannot freeze an agent shell's feature flags into the 24/7 host.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/services_p0_supervision.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-16g/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Core restart, request, and config-layer semantics[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core: make crash-loop stickiness survive capped backoff, add a per-proc [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]restart request with a generation to the service state store, surface [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the pending request in the status snapshot, and make an errored or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unknown-kind config layer fatal instead of invisible.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Restart is a confirmed transition[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]restartgen[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]restartgen: move the sase-core revision pin, rebuild start and restart [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the new request generation, have the host consume requests and record[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the pid it produced, and make the CLI wait for that generation, print [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]old pid to new pid, and fail honestly.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Last-known-good config keeps the host supervising[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]config[dim] · [dim][/dim]after restartgen[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]config: keep the last composition that loaded, observe exits and stop [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]children without reloading config, and publish the config error through [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the heartbeat and the status snapshot instead of going silently stale.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The host honors give_up and says so[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]giveup[dim] · [dim][/dim]after config[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]giveup: stop relaunching procs the restart policy gave up on, keep a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]signature-keyed given-up record that an explicit request clears, emit a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]durable notification on crash-loop and on give-up while desired running,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and make the Telegram receiver exit retryable instead of reporting [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]missing credentials as success.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The CLI and the Services tab show the real failure states[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]surfaces[dim] · [dim][/dim]after giveup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]surfaces: replace the invented failed/error vocabulary with the wire [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]states the core emits, render restart evidence and the host config error[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in the CLI tables and the Services tab, and make an unreadable snapshot [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]read as unknown instead of healthy.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The captured service environment is context-safe[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]env[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]env: stop capturing SASE_FEATURE_FLAGS into the host environment, settle[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the currency check by ignoring volatile keys and normalizing PATH, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refuse an agent-context `sase service init --yes` unless it is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]explicitly allowed.[/#D7D7AF]
